data.name: Haunted Science: Welcome To I.R.H.I.A.
data.detailed_description:
Fraudsters, Hacks, Swindlers, Cheats, names that get tossed around a lot when it comes to dealing with paranormal investigators, but what if we told you that not all of them are making it up on the spot? Would you believe us?

Alright Mel, listen, you’ve been with us for a while now and we need to test Connie on how she’s taught you this far, that’s where the tent comes in. 

Story: 

The tent is set up and the haunted items are ready to play!

You play as an employee of I.R.H.I.A or the Independent Research of Haunted Items Association. Your task is simple, make sure you label all the haunted items you can find and report them….. Hey, is this the coffee I asked for? The cup’s empty?

How It Works:

Walk around the facility and tag items you believe to be haunted before reporting them to make sure you clear their haunted status. Use the control field to double check the haunts you tag before you report them, it’s better to not tag than to tag too many false haunts. Can you surpass the test?

Gameplay Features:

  • Countless Haunts: Almost everything can be haunted and almost everything will be if you manage to partake in the testing long enough.

  • 9 Levels: Having just one test haunt isn’t nearly enough, explore the 9 different test scenarios I.R.H.I.A. has laid out for you. 

  • Multiplayer: Take the test alone or with up to 3 other friends. Just make sure you can trust them because not everyone's story will always match up to yours.

  • Twisted gaslighting mechanics: Not all haunts are created equal and some will make you question if things really are as haunted as they appear, it’s up to you to find the proof of the pudding.

  • A world of lore to explore: it may not be out in the open for you but if you’re willing to dive into it all I.R.H.I.A. has lots of secrets it wants to keep hidden, but will you let them?

Do you have what it takes to pass the I.R.H.I.A.s test? Grab your friends and find out!
